Name: Blackberry Ink
Author: BerryBea
Description:
[b][u][size=4]Blackberry Ink[/size][/u][/b]

Instead of only being able to get squid ink from enemy drops and fishing ponds, this will allow you to craft your own. It renames "squid ink" to "ink" and changes the description to reflect that it may or may not come from a squid. (This allows for a vegan-friendly ink option!)

Updated for Stardew version 1.6! (The old version for Stardew 1.5.6 is still available though.)

[u]How to Craft
[/u][list]
[*]Recipe: 10 blackberries and 1 vinegar
[*]Unlocks at Foraging level 8
[/list]Note that this isn't a profitable recipe if you're buying vinegar from Pierre. I'd recommend using one of several mods that allow you to craft your own vinegar.

[u]Additional Changes?[/u]
This mod does not change the name of Squid Ink Ravioli or its buff in the game. Ink will still drop from Squid Kids and squids in fish ponds, too.

[u]Compatibility[/u]
This mod should be compatible with any mods that do not change the name or description of squid ink. I have not tested it on mobile, nor am I able to do so.

[u]Languages[/u]
This mod was written in English, but I've added Simplified Chinese, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish translations. I used an online translator for this, so please let me know if you see an error in your language and I'll be happy to fix it.

[u]Uninstalling[/u]
Simply delete the [CP] Blackberry Ink folder from your Mods folder.

[u]Fun Fact![/u]
You can make ink from blackberries and vinegar in real life (but I wouldn't recommend a ratio of 1 bottle of vinegar to 10 blackberries)!
